events.evidence: Brazil and China sign an agreement to trade in their own currencies, ceasing the usage of the United States dollar as an intermediary
Evan Gershkovich, an American reporter at The Wall Street Journal, is arrested in Yekaterinburg by Russia's Federal Security Service under charges of espionage
Myanmar's ruling military junta dissolves the National League for Democracy, the political party of former State Counsellor Aung San Suu Kyi

label.note: Brazil-China local-currency trade and Russian arrest of US reporter add tension; Myanmar junta dissolves NLD.
